name: Millissa Nygren
title: Nurse Practitioner
bio: Millissa was born and raised in Colorado. She completed nursing school in Maine in 2013 and worked as a bedside nurse for 13 years in Colorado and Alaska before earning her MSN and becoming a nurse practitioner in 2026. In her free time, Millissa enjoys spending time with her husband and dog. Her hobbies include mountain biking, hiking, skiing, reading, and pottery.
